page0.text:
Both hands on the clock point to the top.
It's midnight, the time we agreed on.

page1.text:
I wrap up the Azoth Blade and keep it on my waist.
It's my only weapon. The only other thing I take with me is the pendant Tohsaka talked about.

page2.text:
"Shirou, Rin's calling for you. She said she'll be waiting outside, so come when you're ready."
Illya will stay here.
It's true that Zouken's targeting Illya, but it's also my wish for her to stay here.

page3.text:
"All right. Tohsaka's waiting outside for me?"
"Yeah. She looked impatient, so you'd better go or she'll start grumbling."

page4.text:
...
I nod at Illya and stand up.
My left arm doesn't hurt anymore.
My functions as a living creature are just slowly being eroded.

page5.text: If I stop, I won't know what I'm doing.

page6.text:
"I'm going, then. Take care, Illya."
"Good luck, Shirou. Come home with Sakura and Rin before dawn, okay?"
I wave at Illya and leave the room.

page7.text:
The living room is silent.
Ten years.
So much has happened here. I've made a lot of memories.
Much of it came recently.
This morning scene became so familiar to me over the last year and a half.

page8.text:
The shed is silent.
It's Shirou Emiya's tiny workshop. A place I spent so much time in, it was like my own bedroom.
This is where I followed in Kiritsugu's footsteps and threw myself into training every night.
When I fell asleep here, sometimes she would come to wake me up.
It feels like it happened a long time ago. I can even remember the smell of the air.

page9.text:
The bedroom is silent.
It's a guestroom that's only been used for the last several days.
There aren't any memories here,
but it reminds me of Sakura.

page10.text:
"...Haah."
I sigh and lean against the wall.
I can't remember.
I can't remember anything that happened in this house, or anything I've experienced.
And yet...
When I walk through these rooms, Sakura's face clearly comes to mind.

page11.text:
"Man, I can't believe..."
...how much Sakura means to me.
It's a struggle to just stay conscious; my memories are all over the place.
The ten years I've spent in this house are turning into a haze.

page12.text:
But there's something I still remember well.
No matter what else I'll lose, the memory of Sakura will always be fresh in my mind.

page13.text:
"..."
I heave a long sigh.
What I need to do has always been the same.

page14.text:
"All right. Let's go, Sakura."
I anchor my disconnected mind, and leave Sakura's room.

page15.text:
I leave nothing behind.
Once, we made a promise here.
We knew we couldn't keep it, but we said it to encourage each other.
